exposure: GnRH agonist trigger for final follicular maturation
cohort: A single patient who developed ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome following GnRH agonist trigger for final follicular maturation, which subsequently masked an extrauterine pregnancy.
finding: This is the first reported case of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) following GnRH agonist trigger for final follicular maturation and freeze-all, which masked an extrauterine pregnancy.
